name: echo-stack
title: Echo Stack
description: A word focuses in at the center while outline copies of it unfold above and below and keep drifting, like the one clear line on a spinning drum.
useWhen: A one-word statement (a value, a promise) should hold the screen for a while and still feel alive.
Repetition should add weight to a word without adding any other text.
A beat in a sequence of single words, where each word gets the same treatment and only the text changes.
avoidWhen: The word should just appear and stay still: use focus-blur-resolve.
The repeats should run sideways as a strip of text: use infinite-marquee.
The screen should fill with rows of text rather than a column around one word: use type-wall.
author: Remocn
